source_doc: US Army Air Forces map 'Russian & Manchurian Strategic Urban Areas', drawn by J R Hagan, 31 Aug 1945, Top Secret; Wikimedia Commons cites it to Norstad to Groves, 'Atomic Bomb Production', 15 Sep 1945 (MED Top Secret correspondence, NARA M1109, roll 1, target 4, folder 3)
source_page: single sheet; bottom-left chart (x 120-300, y 1180-1350 of the 1920 px image)
notes: Read from the 1920 px Commons thumbnail (the 3972 px original was rate-limited). Chart lists cities with the share of Soviet output they hold; no per-city priority or bomb count. Link to Norstad's 15 first-priority targets (39 bombs) is inferred, not stated on the map.
